project.name: AIOS context compiler
project.identity: The AIOS file-backed Context Compiler that turns routed inputs into context briefings and receipts.
project.audience: Agents and operators who need relevant, reproducible context for a task.
project.core_loop: Route a task, select governed inputs, compile a briefing, and emit a receipt that explains what was included.
project.north_star: A task receives the smallest relevant context packet with enough provenance to reproduce and inspect it.
not_this: Treating generated context as source truth

scope.purpose: Compile the smallest deterministic task context from file-backed routing rules, source material, and durable project truth.
scope.boundary: Owns aios/context routing, compilation, generated briefings, and context receipts; dashboard projection and learning-loop policy remain outside this child.
non_goals: Treating generated context as source truth
